archetypes.name: handoff-status
archetypes.rationale: Step 3 wrapper fallback and loop-status remapping are the highest-risk behavior change.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 3 wrapper handoff paths for empty result-env, stdout fallback, and legacy LOOP_STATUS-only cases. Check that operational statuses are not overwritten by persistence failures and that zero-findings-degraded-panel is not treated as a successful completion. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: launcher-stdin
archetypes.rationale: The Cursor stdin redirect touches shared external launcher plumbing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review launch-review.sh Cursor spawn semantics around run-external-agent, stderr sidecars, backgrounding, and serial-lock release. Verify the /dev/null redirect changes only stdin inheritance and does not alter argv, sidecar timing, or Codex behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
